q1_issues.issue: (Patient (sk_rise $x) $x) mis-slots the intransitive subject: a wraith is an animate self-powered mover, which the subject test assigns Agent, while Patient is reserved for change-of-state undergoers (collapse, melt, freeze) and non-volitional natural processes (rain, smoke, tides).

notes: The rest is exactly the negated-verbal-generic doctrine: an explicit 'no' quantifier takes the distributing Implication at strength 0.0 / confidence 0.9 plus the QuantifierPhrase companion, and the backward-window adverbial is correctly (WithinLast ... 26 year) inside the denied bundle rather than a duration Measure. The animate-emergence sense of 'rise' sits near the instruction set's unaccusative boundary, so the role call is arguable but Agent is what the stated test yields.
